title: Flow Party Sydney
description: Single-page site for FLOW, Sydney's biggest Brazilian queer party — covering the brand's mission and community, a visual timeline of past editions, the team, and sponsors.

title: Fearless Pong
description: Browser-based Pong built for a "Fearless Play" campaign, built while at The Hallway, with canvas gameplay, keyboard controls, and custom start, pause, win, and game-over screens styled around the campaign branding.

title: Suicide Hotline
description: IP-geolocated redirect that surfaces the right local suicide-prevention hotline number for 89+ countries, with an emergency-services fallback link for when life is in immediate danger.

title: iCloudy
description: Bilingual (PT/EN) corporate site for iCloudy, a Brazilian IT consultancy specializing in network infrastructure, information security, and technology innovation.
